rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts forever, especially in formal or abstract contexts.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 oi3 hai6 wing5 hang4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for something that is continuously present or consistently the same rather than specifically everlasting.

example.english: This shop is an eternal source of free tea.
example.traditional: 呢間舖恆常供應免費茶水。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 hang4 soeng4 gung1 jing3 min5 fai3 caa4 seoi2
